description: A term's definition or a claim's title and statement in other languages, as other sites are shown them (PM-1373): for each language a person wrote a translation in, or the thing's links carry or pages asked for — 'state' human (a person's, shown with no mark; 'outdated' true when the source was edited since), machine (the model's, shown marked «Machine-translated from …»; 'sourceLang' the language it was written in), pending (not translated yet: shown as written until the background pass gets to it) or original (already in that language) — with the words themselves, so a machine translation can be taken, corrected and saved with set_registry_translation. Only for somebody who may write in the project and, for a term, open its source.

id.description: The term's id (list_terms) or the claim's (list_claims).
